body.name: Closure-complete log-difference system
body.construction: For component \(c\) and sign \(\zeta\in\{+,-\}\), the nonzero stratum uses \(x_i=\log|b_i|\). Each ratio edge contributes \(x_j-x_k\le\log u_{jk}\) and \(x_k-x_j\le-\log\ell_{jk}\); the sign-adjusted box contributes the finite log lower and upper bounds that exist. These inequalities form \(\mathcal D_c^{\zeta}\). Add a separate all-zero stratum exactly when \(0\in[\nu^-_i,\nu^+_i]\) for every \(i\in c\).
